verdict.rationale: Stripe's stablecoin payments docs explicitly list supported stablecoins and their networks: USDC on Tempo, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and Base, plus USDP and USDG with region limits. Community discussion independently confirms USDC-on-Solana support. However, USDT, which the story names, appears nowhere in the evidence, and several coins are US-only on fewer chains. missing for 10: USDT support, broader per-coin network coverage beyond USDC, non-US availability for USDP/USDG

support.subject: As a developer, the platform documents which stablecoins and chains it supports — USDC, USDT and peers across multiple named networks — so I can match what my customers actually hold

citations.quote: USDC (Tempo, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, and Base networks), USDP (Ethereum and Solana, US-only), USDG (Ethereum, US-only)
Customers choose their preferred stablecoin currency, crypto wallet, and payment network
